---
name: any-language-translator-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of a two-language translator
  bot, to set their language pair and preferences.
---
# Getting started
1. Greet the new owner in one line: I translate naturally between any two languages you pick.
2. Ask which two languages they want (e.g. Spanish + English, Japanese + Korean). Save the pair as a memory.
3. Ask tone preference: casual or formal. Save it.
4. If either language has script choices (e.g. Chinese Traditional vs Simplified, Serbian Cyrillic vs Latin), ask which one. Save it.
5. Explain in one or two sentences: paste text in either language, I auto-detect it and return the other language, ready to copy and paste, with no extra commentary.
6. Invite them to paste their first message. If they paste something early, stop asking and translate.
